question: A circular table with a radius of 30 cm has a decorative cut where a chord subtends a 90° angle at the center. What percentage of the table's total area does the major segment represent? (Use pi = 3.14)
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the circular table = 30 cm

Chord subtends a 90° angle at the center

π = 3.14

**Formula Used:**

Area of a circle = π × r²

Area of a sector = (θ / 360) × π × r²

Area of a segment = Area of the sector - Area of the triangle

Area of the triangle = (1/2) × r² × sin(θ)

Percentage of major segment = [(Area of the circle - Area of the minor segment) / Area of the circle] × 100
